subject: Request: staggered invoicing & Net-90 term for StellarGrid PO
messages:
From: Alison Park <apark@stellargrid.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellargrid.com, Tom Carver <tcarver@stellargrid.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Net-90 + staggered invoicing for upcoming engagement

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. The team at StellarGrid is excited to move forward but we have one ask from procurement that will determine timing: they require Net-90 payment terms and want invoices split across the quarter (staggered invoicing: 40% on kickoff, 30% mid-term, 30% on completion).

Budget closes on Nov 30, and to hit that cadence procurement needs a PO and signed SOW by Nov 18. I know Net-90 is outside standard terms — please let me know the steps on your side and who I should expect to hear back from for approvals.

Attaching a draft PO template and their procurement note (see attachment stub: StellarGrid_PO_1126.pdf).

Best,
Alison
Alison Park
Sr. Procurement Manager | StellarGrid
apark@stellargrid.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: StellarGrid_PO_1126.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <apark@stellargrid.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net-90 + staggered invoicing for upcoming engagement

Alison — thanks for the clear timeline and the PO stub. I understand the ask and will escalate to our deal desk and finance immediately.

Quick notes from our side:
- Net-90 is non-standard for Redwood and requires finance approval (cc'ing Rishi).
- Staggered invoicing is workable as a one-off if we add an explicit credit/retainer clause or modify payment triggers.
- We can push an approved SOW + amendment back to you by EOD Nov 15 if terms are agreed internally.

Laura / Rishi — looping you both for a decision. Customer requests Net-90 with 40/30/30 split (see attached PO). This is a new billing cadence for us on this deal; StellarGrid is committed and wants a signed SOW by Nov 18 to close their budget window. Can we approve Net-90 and under what conditions (retainer, credit checks, finance fee, or discount impact)?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net-90 + staggered invoicing for upcoming engagement

Diego — thanks for flagging. A couple of operational considerations from GTM:

- Revenue recognition: split invoicing is fine, but we need clear acceptance milestones in the SOW to align invoicing triggers.
- Discount/comp: if we accept Net-90 we should not increase discount; instead prefer a contractual mitigation (retainer or finance fee) so quota and ARR don't get distorted.
- Risk appetite: StellarGrid is mid-market but a repeatable account; if we can get a 10% refundable retainer and DocuSign guarantee, I'm inclined to greenlight.

Rishi — can finance weigh in on whether a 10% retainer + credit hold clause is sufficient, or if you need a different structure (e.g., 1.5% finance fee on Net-90)? I want to get this back to Alison before EOD Monday (Nov 15) to meet their PO deadline.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-14T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net-90 + staggered invoicing for upcoming engagement

Team — reviewed StellarGrid's request and their last 12-month payment history (procurement included a credit reference). Proposed finance position below:

Decision: conditional approval for Net-90 with staggered invoicing. Conditions:
- 10% refundable retainer due within 14 days of SOW signature (applied to final invoice).
- Add a credit hold clause: missed payment beyond agreed Net window triggers suspension and 30-day cure period.
- Include a 1% finance processing fee spread across invoices (to cover extended receivables).

Rationale: this maintains commercial flexibility while protecting cash flow. No changes to list pricing or sales commission treatment — don't reduce commission for this.

Please draft an amendment (SG credit amendment) with the above clauses and attach to the SOW. Once Alison confirms acceptance we can sign and legal will countersign.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <apark@stellargrid.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, procurement@stellargrid.com
Date: 2026-11-15T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net-90 + staggered invoicing for upcoming engagement

Alison — good news. Finance has approved Net-90 with the conditions below (outlined in the attached amendment):

- 10% refundable retainer due within 14 days of SOW signature (applies to final invoice).
- Invoices will be issued per the split you requested: 40% kickoff / 30% mid-term / 30% completion.
- 1% finance processing fee applied across invoices.
- Standard credit hold clause: missed payment triggers suspension after a 30-day cure period.

I've attached the updated SOW (StellarGrid_SOW_v3.pdf) and the credit amendment (SG_credit_amendment.docx) for your review and countersignature. If that looks good, please confirm and send the PO to procurement@redwood.com; we'll countersign as soon as we see the retainer payment initiation.

We can meet the Nov 18 window if we get a PO + retainer authorization by Nov 17.

Thanks — excited to get started.
Diego Fernandez
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Diego_fernandez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: StellarGrid_SOW_v3.pdf, SG_credit_amendment.docx

- Process the 10% retainer this week and send proof of payment to procurement@redwood.com.
- Issue PO with the staggered invoicing schedule and Net-90 terms by COB Nov 17.

Please proceed with countersignature workflows; I'll circulate DocuSign once we have the PO number. Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Alison
